name: Carmen Fernandez
about-me-text:
I am a Salesforce Engineer with professional experience developing and maintaining Salesforce applications using Flow, Apex, and Lightning Web Components (LWC). My work includes batch processing, external API integrations, system maintenance, error investigation, and implementing business features in a production environment.
I have developed strong implementation skills through hands-on Salesforce development and continuous technical learning, earning four Salesforce certifications. Fluent in both English and Japanese (JLPT N1), I bring strong communication skills, adaptability, and the ability to quickly understand requirements and translate them into practical technical solutions.
In addition to my Salesforce experience, I continue to expand my web development skills through personal projects using React, JavaScript, and Node.js, with a strong interest in building user-focused and scalable applications.
project-1: Budget Planning & Sales Forecast System (Salesforce LWC / Apex)
project-1-description: Implemented a Salesforce system supporting budget planning and sales forecasting operations. Developed hierarchical grid-based LWC interfaces, Apex Batch processing for aggregating actual sales and pending shipment data, and integration between the frontend and batch processing. Implemented the system end-to-end from the LWC interface through Batch Apex processing, contributing to the automation and efficiency of budget and sales management workflows.
project-2-description:
This React-based music search app lets users search for songs and create custom playlists. Users can save their playlists directly to their own Spotify accounts using the Spotify API.
By integrating with Spotify, I gained hands-on experience with external APIs, learned how to manage state effectively, and handled form inputs—all essential React fundamentals applied in a real-world context.
project-3-description: This React app is a simple café management tool featuring a card-based UI where users can add or remove their favorite cafés from a list. Clicking a card immediately updates the state, showcasing effective use of React’s state management and component design fundamentals. The app is thoughtfully styled to ensure an intuitive and seamless user experience.
project-4: External Diagnostic API Integration (Salesforce Flow / Apex / Batch Apex)
project-4-description: Implemented an external diagnostic API integration for maintenance contract records in Salesforce. Developed Screen Flow logic for user input and validation, Apex HTTP Callouts, and Batch Apex processing for bulk record operations. Integrated with an existing folder-creation subflow to support both individual execution and bulk processing workflows for external system integration.
project-5: Product Proposal Synchronization Batch (Salesforce Apex / Batch Apex)
project-5-description: Implemented Apex Batch processing to aggregate and synchronize product proposal information with Opportunity records in Salesforce. Based on functional specifications, developed incremental processing for updated records, data aggregation and grouping, output size control, and execution timestamp management. Leveraged shared processing components to support multiple product categories while implementing a scalable batch process capable of handling large volumes of data reliably.
